chunks: The statement between the Yemeni Corner and the corner in which is the Black Stone.
And say between these two corners:
Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us by Your mercy from the punishment of the Fire.

key_terms.رَبَّنَا: Our Lord; a direct address to Allah in supplication
key_terms.ٱلرُّكْنِ ٱلْيَمَانِيِّ: the Yemeni Corner of the Ka'bah
key_terms.ٱلْحَجَرُ ٱلْأَسْوَدُ: the Black Stone set in the Ka'bah

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone during hajj?
ai.summary: This passage teaches a supplication to be recited during hajj between the Yemeni Corner and the corner of the Black Stone. It combines asking for goodness in this world and the Hereafter with seeking protection from the punishment of the Fire through Allah's mercy.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: SUPPLICATIONS BETWEEN THE YEMENI CORNER AND THE CORNER OF THE BLACK STONE
"Our Lord (azj), grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us by Your mercy from the punishment of the Fire."
